sections.title: Aura, live
sections.intro: Premium sport dials: chrome rings, a warm glow behind white numerals and big digital numbers, on graphite leather. This is the real wallpaper, drawn in your browser by the app's own code. Tap the big gauge, and try Aura's layouts and colours.

sections.title: About Aura
sections.intro: Aura is a premium sports car's dials: chrome rings with a warm glow behind white numerals, and big digital numbers, all on graphite leather.

items.alt: The Aura style, as the wallpaper draws it
items.caption: Aura, drawn by the app itself

items.title: €2.39, once
items.text: Buy Aura once on Google Play and it's yours. On a new phone with the same Google account, it comes back by itself.

items.title: One dial, three jobs
items.text: The big gauge shows power, CPU clock or GPS speed. Tap it on your home screen to switch, as in every style.

items.title: Make it yours
items.text: Customize sets Aura's colours and background, and its units, clock and warning lights.

items.title: Layouts, and your own
items.text: Most styles come in several layouts. You can also drag and resize the gauges and save your own.

sections.title: Layouts made with Aura
sections.intro: Drivers built these layouts in Aura and shared them in the app's layout market, most used first. Every layout works in every style.

sections.title: More styles
sections.intro: Every style runs live on its own page. Or try them all in your browser.

image.alt: The Pulse style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Pulse
items.text: A neon HUD of rings: every reading a ring of light around the big number, magenta on black.

image.alt: The Vector style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Vector
items.text: A neon HUD in hexagons: a faceted sweep that thickens as it climbs and crisp thin digits, violet on black.

image.alt: The Horizon style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Horizon
items.text: A fighter jet's head-up display: sliding tapes, the value boxed between them and a time strip, green on black.

image.alt: The Classic style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Classic
items.text: The 2016 dashboard: five gauges, an LCD clock and warning lights.
